what: are the 28 gpu/cpu/tps OWED bodies actually unexecutable, or is mlx_lm missing a module?
method: Read each specimen config.json model_type (or text_config.model_type). Match against filenames in mlx_lm.models (118 modules). Do NOT import mlx_lm — that package's __init__ touches mx.random.state and dies with metal::load_device in this sandbox. Listing the models directory is the same evidence the existing gpu REFUSED reasons use ('mlx_lm has no module for model_type X'), without loading a weight.
result: ALL 28 gpu-OWED bodies HAVE an mlx_lm.models file. Zero would be an honest 'no module' refusal. The remaining physical axes are owed GPU measurement, not missing Python modules.
consequence: Stamping gpu/cpu/tps REFUSED on these 28 would be the defect G034 was built to catch: a blank disguised as a finding. They stay OWED. G009 cannot reach axes_owed 0 in a process that cannot load mlx_lm.
blocked_by: unsandboxed Metal (--profile gate). Free RAM at attempt was 37-53 GB.
